query: SELECT DATE(ur.created_at) AS "date!: NaiveDate", COALESCE(SUM(ur.cost_usd), 0) AS "spend_usd!", COALESCE(SUM(ur.input_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "input_tokens!", COALESCE(SUM(ur.output_tokens), 0)::bigint AS "output_tokens!" FROM usage_records ur WHERE ur.workspace_id = $1 AND ur.created_at >= $2 AND ur.created_at < $3 GROUP BY DATE(ur.created_at) ORDER BY DATE(ur.created_at)
